description:
Salesforce Developer (m/f/d)
 

Ref.-No.: JR1014950



Position Summary

CWS Hygiene is the market leader in sustainable hand and toilet hygiene and one of the driving forces behind a healthier, safer, and more sustainable future. Across Europe, thousands of colleagues work every day to make a difference for our customers, our communities, and the environment.


As our digital landscape continues to evolve, we are investing in the transformation and modernization of our global CRM ecosystem. To support this journey, we are looking for a Senior Salesforce Developer to join our international IT Lead to Quote (LTQ) team.


This role focuses on strengthening our in-house Salesforce development capabilities and supporting the ongoing evolution of our global Salesforce platform. You will play a key role in developing, enhancing, and integrating Salesforce solutions while contributing to a major CRM transformation initiative that aims to consolidate multiple Salesforce environments into a single scalable platform.


This is a hybrid role. We are open to candidates based in Germany or any other EU country where CWS Hygiene has a legal entity. Candidates should be willing to travel occasionally to support workshops, team meetings, and project-related activities across Europe.


Mission

Customer relationship management is a critical enabler of growth, operational excellence, and customer experience at CWS Hygiene. In this role, you will help build and evolve our Salesforce platform while supporting an ambitious transformation program that will shape the future of CRM across Europe.


You will become an important member of our internal Salesforce team. Working closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Salesforce Architects, Administrators, Developers, and external implementation partners, you will design and develop scalable solutions that support business growth and operational excellence.


What makes this role unique is the combination of hands-on development, international collaboration, and transformation impact. You will not simply maintain an existing platform. You will actively contribute to the modernization, consolidation, and future development of our Salesforce landscape while helping strengthen internal expertise and reducing dependency on external development partners.


Key Responsibilities

  • You will design, develop, test, and deploy Salesforce solutions that support business processes across multiple European markets.
  • Your work will include developing Apex code, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flows, and custom platform functionality while ensuring adherence to Salesforce best practices and development standards.
  • You will collaborate closely with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and Architects to translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
  • You will build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise platforms, including ERP, eCommerce, Marketing, and customer service systems, using REST and SOAP APIs.
  • You will support change requests, defect resolution, testing activities, releases, and continuous improvement initiatives while helping maintain platform stability and performance.
  • You will contribute to code reviews, technical documentation, and development standards to ensure high-quality and sustainable solutions.
  • You will support DevOps and CI/CD processes, helping to improve development efficiency, deployment quality, and release management practices.
  • You will contribute to the consolidation of multiple Salesforce organizations into a unified global platform, helping reduce technical debt and increase standardization across the business.
  • As an internal Salesforce expert, you will support knowledge sharing, collaborate with colleagues across Europe, and contribute to building long-term internal development capabilities.

Requirements

At CWS Hygiene, we know that technical expertise is only part of the story. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, takes ownership, and has a genuine passion for building high-quality Salesforce solutions.


Ideally, you bring:

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a comparable field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification.
  • Strong experience with Apex development.
  • Strong experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Experience with Salesforce Flow and declarative automation.
  • Experience with Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using REST APIs and/or SOAP APIs.
  • Experience with source control, CI/CD pipelines, and Salesforce DevOps practices.
  • Experience troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues in enterprise environments.
  • Understanding of Salesforce security, sharing models, and platform best practices.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Fluent English language skills.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer II certification, JavaScript Developer certification, Agentforce knowledge, CRM transformation experience, or experience in international organizations are considered an advantage.

What do we offer?

Working at CWS Hygiene means joining an international organization where collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life.


You will become part of a supportive environment where people are encouraged to learn, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. We offer the opportunity to work with modern Salesforce technologies, collaborate with colleagues across Europe, and make a visible impact on one of the company's most important CRM transformation initiatives.


In addition, we offer an attractive compensation package with a competitive base salary, depending on your country of residence and relevant experience. We also offer flexible working arrangements, modern IT equipment, and a culture that values both personal and professional development.


About CWS Hygiene 

With innovative, sustainable, and digitalized service solutions, CWS Hygiene ensures health, safety, and protection in the workplace and in public spaces.


The complete solutions include hand and washroom hygiene for small to large sanitary facilities as well as clean entrances and exits with mats in building complexes, public buildings, and industrial facilities. CWS Hygiene

stands for sustainability: thanks to its rental model, the company offers its customers a so-called "circular economy," thereby contributing to a healthier and safer future. More than 65,000 existing customers in Germany are supported by over 1,500 employees, with a total workforce of 4,000 across Europe. 


CWS Hygiene operates in 15 European countries and is owned by Franz Haniel & Cie. GmbH.
